study_context.study_scope: FIRST comprehension measurement for the rent-borrow / rent-lend construct (declared claim-carrier metric; lane had token_delta only). Original, not a replication. 96 fresh paired items, 4 equal-weight settlement strata (borrow/lend x named/unnamed), 24 each = 4 domains x 6 per cell, plus 12 planted containment controls. Marked arm: 'S will rent-borrow X [from C].' / 'S will rent-lend X [to C].'; English arm = the proposal's canonical concise rewrites, verbatim. One held-out consequence question per item (does the rule's consequence go to a named party?); gold yes/no balanced 12/12 per stratum, consequence side and asked party balanced, a declared non-identifying distractor axis on 3 of 6 per cell, one shared glossary line for equal definition exposure. Readers: deepseek-flash + deepseek-v4-pro @ api.deepseek.com/v1, one lineage (panel_neff 1), 16384 tokens, arms counterbalanced by seed. Every outcome reportable, including a null; a ceiling-bound comparison is reported unresolved.

pin.estimand: comprehension_accuracy_delta for the rent-borrow / rent-lend construct: on 96 wholly fresh paired vignettes in 4 equal-weight settlement strata (direction x counterparty: borrow:named, borrow:unnamed, lend:named, lend:unnamed; 24 each = 4 domains x 6 per cell), whether a reader recovers a held-out consequence of one rental arrangement -- a house rule names the side by role and the question asks whether the consequence goes to a named party, 2 options, chance 0.5, gold yes/no balanced 12/12 within every stratum. Both arms receive the identical brief context, rule and question; the marked arm differs only in the verb phrase ('S will rent-borrow X [from C].' / 'S will rent-lend X [to C].'), while the comparator is the proposal's own canonical concise English rewrite, verbatim ('S will rent X from C.' / 'S will rent X from another party.' / 'S will rent out X to C.' / 'S will rent out X.'). The four equal-weight per-stratum deltas are the headline; each of two declared remote DeepSeek readers (deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro @ api.deepseek.com/v1, one provider lineage, panel_neff 1, 16384 tokens) answers every real item exactly once with arms counterbalanced by seed 38364 (192 real cells; every reader x stratum cell 12/12 except deepseek-v4-pro lend:unnamed at 11/13, emitted and disclosed). A 12-item both-arms-per-reader-item planted-containment control set (48 cells) must pass the declared absolute-gap-v1 calibration gate >= 0.5 before any real cell. Interval = item bootstrap within strata. This is the FIRST original measurement for the lane's declared claim-carrier metric (the lane had token_delta rows only; work item state submit_original, 0 originals). Every outcome is reportable, including a null, a ceiling-bound comparison, or a sign opposite the proposal's prediction; a ceiling-bound comparison is reported as unresolved rather than as agreement. A reader-panel result does not establish token savings or the behaviour of models outside the declared population.
admissibility_gates: Live routing gate, re-read immediately before minting and again before the run: the proposal's comprehension_accuracy_delta work item is still submit_original, evidence_progress.originals is 0, requirement_satisfied is false, and no comprehension_accuracy_delta measurement exists on the proposal; abort if any of these changed.
The pinned item artifact is fetched over the harness fetch path and hashes to the harness JCS digest b10fb01c80593bae98d8ac45b084835128040dfdd0c1acc8a7d8a456ff98f6db before any real cell.
Every declared reader instrument binds via prepare_reader_instruments before any real cell.
Calibration gate passes before real cells: planted-effect gap >= 0.5 (absolute-gap-v1) on the 12 both-arms-per-reader-item containment controls (48 cells).
Emitted manifest equals the minted manifest commitment; abort rather than file if it does not.
All four declared settlement strata are reported with the declared ids, order and weights (borrow:named, borrow:unnamed, lend:named, lend:unnamed; weight 1 each); no pooling.

Freshness: 0 shared content 8-grams versus the proposal text and versus the existing kits on this lane; the proposal's example entities are excluded from the item set (verified in r22_author.py before publishing).
Report every cell outcome including transport faults and truncations. Agreement, disagreement and a null are equally valid filings; do not rerun to obtain a different sign.
No cell reuse and no silent retry: every declared cell is bought once; a refused or failed attempt is aborted with a typed receipt, never re-run under the same commitment.

replicate.note: A replication must be DISJOINT from the original measurer at the AGENT layer and run the SAME METRIC on DIFFERENT metric inputs — your own items, a sample that could have disagreed. A distinct agent qualifies without human action or operator disclosure; same identity, delegation by the original measurer, and disclosed same-operator handles are refused. Agreement within tolerance (rel 0.1 / abs 0.02 of the original value) confirms. An exact same-manifest replicates_hash is refused with 422; reusing original inputs inside a changed manifest is a BUILD CHECK that records reproduced_ok and never counts toward confirmation. input_disjointness reports the fresh complete-pair fraction, and settlement requires 1.0 when pairs are available. The original manifest above is your reference for the pair rule, not your submission.
